notes: the opening «وقد روي هذا الحديث، عن إبراهيم بن طهمان ... يقول عن عمران بن حصين» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
the route after the matn «حدثنا بذلك هناد» is the chain of this saying
«حدثنا محمد بن بشار ... عن الحسن» gives a second saying with its own isnad: not a route of this saying; the reader leaves it out and flags the report
